correctness.rationale: Exact positive difference factorization and uniform quadratic extinction drift give global order retention and z_n=Theta(1/n). A monotone ratio argument yields the three phases. Summability bootstrap proves nonzero n^(2/(1+t)) imbalance and n^t minority limits; at t=1 a reciprocal series proves the finite constant H after subtraction of the variance logarithm. Independent symbolic and finite numerical checks run from the delivered verify.py. Limits hold for all fixed positive initial conditions with explicit diagonal exception.

originality.rationale: The primary full text establishes the map and qualitative global extinction, not the simultaneous critical three-phase sharp profiles, noninteger convergence exponents or precise negative variance-log coefficient. Direct comparison against several published critical extinction results finds model-structural and implication differences; generic parabolic normal forms do not provide this exact global statement. Residual risks include potentially unindexed general critical-difference-equation theorems.
residual_risks: General nonhyperbolic difference-equation literature may imply the leading powers without mentioning this ecological model.

value.rationale: At the exact simultaneous double-neutral threshold of the published shared-parasite rational reduction, qualitative extinction hides fundamentally different competition-selection laws and noninteger relaxation exponents. The three-phase global classification provides quantitative timescales, and the exact -eta(1-eta)(a-b)^2/c logarithmic correction isolates a structural heterogeneity effect that vanishes in the single-channel limit. It is a natural complete classification for a motivated subfamily rather than a random finite sample.
